title: Protect grounded XRD report communication quality
root_cause: The deterministic report composer supported discussion/conclusion fallbacks, but XRD-specific communication quality was not protected by a focused regression.

change.behavior: Added an XRD report case asserting discussion and conclusion retain the authoritative matched-peak fact, limitations remain present, and ReportGroundingValidator accepts the output.

assertions: Discussion and conclusion are grounded to xrd.matched_peak_count.
The test does not create a new scientific Result or recompute science.
